name: SigNoz v0.145 APM for Railway Apps
description: Logs, traces and metrics in one place. OpenTelemetry-native Datadog alternative.

PORT.description: ClickHouse HTTP port; Railway probes /ping on it.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: Password of the ClickHouse `default` user (alphanumeric so it is DSN-safe).

CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.description: Lets the default user manage SQL users/roles.

CLICKHOUSE_KEEPER_HOST.description: Private hostname of the Keeper service.

CLICKHOUSE_DSN.description: Native-protocol DSN that SigNoz services reference.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time ClickHouse gets to flush and stop cleanly on redeploy.

PORT.description: Keeper HTTP control port; Railway probes /ready on it.

schema-migrator.startCommand: /bin/sh -c '/signoz-otel-collector migrate ready && /signoz-otel-collector migrate bootstrap && /signoz-otel-collector migrate sync up && /signoz-otel-collector migrate async up'

SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_DSN.description: ClickHouse DSN the migrations run against.

SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER.description: Cluster name defined in the ClickHouse config.

SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_REPLICA.description: Create Replicated tables (upstream default; uses Keeper).

SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_TIMEOUT.description: How long each migrate step waits for ClickHouse.

SIGNOZ_TELEMETRYSTORE_CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER.description: Cluster name defined in the ClickHouse config.

SIGNOZ_SQLSTORE_PROVIDER.description: Metadata store (users, dashboards, alerts). SQLite on the service volume.

SIGNOZ_USER_ROOT_ENABLED.description: Provision the admin (root) user at start-up instead of an open sign-up page.

SIGNOZ_USER_ROOT_EMAIL.description: REQUIRED: email you will log in with as admin.

SIGNOZ_USER_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Admin password (generated; meets SigNoz complexity rules). Read it from Variables.

SIGNOZ_USER_ROOT_ORG_NAME.description: Organisation created for the admin user.

SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_EXTERNAL__URL.description: Public URL of the UI (used in links).

SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_INGESTION__URL.description: OTLP ingest URL shown in onboarding screens.

SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_EXTERNAL__URL.description: Base URL used in alert notifications.

SIGNOZ_STATSREPORTER_ENABLED.description: Upstream default. Set false to stop sending usage stats (incl. user emails) to SigNoz Inc.

CLICKHOUSE_DSN.description: ClickHouse DSN the exporters write to.

SIGNOZ_HOST.description: SigNoz private hostname for the OpAMP channel (log pipelines).

SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_TIMEOUT.description: How long start-up waits for the schema migration.

OTLP_PUBLIC_TOKEN.description: Bearer token required on the PUBLIC OTLP endpoints (domain / TCP proxy).

LOW_CARDINAL_EXCEPTION_GROUPING.description: Group exceptions by type+service only (lower cardinality).
